briefdescription.para: Re-register custom error actions for all EVENT-class notifiers.

detaileddescription.para: After an in-place PLM update, XPlmi_ReconfigErrActions() clears all custom error actions. This function must be called during post-update init to restore the XPmNotifier_Event handler for every EVENT-class entry that was preserved in PmNotifiers[] across the update.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if all restores succeeded; otherwise the first error code returned by XPlmi_EmSetAction().

briefdescription.para: Check whether the caller has registered notifiers covering EVERY requested event-mask bit for the given subsystem and node.

detaileddescription.para: Used by GET_EVENT_STATUS_REGS as the permission gate: the requested Mask must be a subset of the bits registered by the caller for {NodeId}, otherwise a caller registered for one bit could read/clear another bit via an OR'd mask.

parameterdescription.para: Requested event mask (all bits must be registered)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if every requested bit is registered; XPM_PM_NO_ACCESS otherwise.
